title: Your exam resit slot expires in an hour
scenario: A text claiming to be from the exams office says your resit slot will be released to someone else in one hour unless you secure it now with a payment to a listed account.

answers.A: Pay quickly to the account in the text to keep the slot.
answers.B: Check the resit booking directly through the official student portal instead of the link in the text.
answers.C: Pay, and also forward the message to classmates so they don't lose their slots either.

explanation: Exam administration doesn't run through a one-hour countdown to a payment account named in a text - a real resit booking lives in the student portal.
proTip: Anything that decides your academic record happens in the official portal, not a text link.
